messages:
devon: Heads-up — running the sampleapp CLI (batching helper) against /v1/embeddings then feeding outputs into /v1/rerank is failing in the wild. Root error is a 400 about vector dims not matching.
abby: Can you paste the request payload and the exact error text? also which model + sdk/version?
devon: sure — using python sampleapp v0.3.2, model=openembed-1024. Payload (trimmed):
```
POST /v1/embeddings
{
  "model": "openembed-1024",
  "input": ["doc A", "doc B", "doc C", "doc D"]
}
```
Server error: `400 Bad Request: embedding dimension 1536 != model dimension 1024`
kevin: odd — 1536 is typical for the node default embed model we vendor. Are any cached embeddings getting mixed in? or different model id returned by the rerank helper?
devon: the batching helper merges cached prefix embeddings (from local disk) with fresh batch outputs before sending to rerank. I dumped the combined array and one of the elements is length 1536.
abby: is the cache written by the node sample app or python? parity issue possibility.
devon: cache was populated by the desktop-cli (node) months ago. sampleapp (python) assumes cache dims=1024 and doesn't validate on load. When we stitch the arrays we don't normalize keys either.
nina: we've seen two separate parity problems recently: 1) different SDKs expose embeddings under different keys (node: `vectors`, python: `embedding`), 2) implicit model-id drift where `openembed` -> `openembed-1536` on node. Rerank helper expects a canonical `embedding` list of floats with length matching the target model.
kevin: also noticed auth/retry quirk: if token expires mid-batch the retry code replays the whole batch but doesn't refresh the token header, so first retry gets 401 then a partial-mismatch flow causes 400s. Log snippet:
```
HTTP 401 Token expired
retrying batch (attempt 2)
HTTP 400 {"error":"embedding dimension 1536 != model dimension 1024"}
```
abby: ugh. So two separate fixes: validate cached embedding dims on load, and ensure retry refreshes auth before replaying.
devon: agreed. I'll open a small patch on the sampleapp to: 1) reject cache items with wrong length (log and drop), 2) normalize keys to `embedding`, 3) make the retry refresh token via auth client before replay.
kevin: add a unit test that writes a fake cache file with 1536 dims and ensures it's rejected. also add an integration test that simulates token-expiry mid-batch (stub auth client returning expired -> refreshed token).
abby: I'll pick up the unit tests and a sample CLI repro. devon — can you paste a minimal curl that reproduces the 400 so I can add it to the test harness?
devon: minimal repro (uses patched cache path):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/v1/embeddings \
 -H "Authorization: Bearer <EXPIRED_TOKEN>" \
 -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
 -d '{"model":"openembed-1024","input":["x","y","z"]}'
```
then simulate cache with 1536-length vector and run rerank.
nina: :sparkles: great. can we also add a short note to the SDK parity doc about `embedding` vs `vectors` keys and a migration snippet?
devon: yep. I'll include migration snippet and link to sampleapp PR. thanks!
deploy-bot: deploy queued: sampleapp/patch-embed-cache-validation -> staging
kevin: after deploy let's run the regression job `devex/embedding-parity` against a few cached corpora.
abby: on it — will post results here. :thumbsup:
